prompt: The client's costs are rising and it wants to know where to look first. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Overhead has stayed at 20 every year
options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.
That misreads the chart: Labor grew 8% (50 to 54); materials grew 60%.

options.text: Supplier price increases caused the materials rise
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

options.text: Materials drive most of the cost increase
options.feedback: Right. Total cost rose 22 (100 to 122); materials account for 18 of it (30 to 48).
